short_blurb: Remodels, additions & ADUs — licensed general contractor in Burbank.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to Burbank. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout Burbank, including Magnolia Park, Rancho, Media District, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Burbank?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Burbank building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Burbank?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Burbank rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Burbank remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
